column1: # Pinned competitor libraries and checkouts for competitors/setup.sh (spec §8.2–8.7).
# Toolchain pins (Rust channel, oha, wrk, .NET channel, version floors) live at the top of setup.sh.
#   vendorlock  source = name in vendor/manifest.tsv; the commit is that suite's <name>.lock
#               (the existing pins, spec §8.2 — not duplicated here; pin/check are "-")
#   git         source = clone URL; pin = tag or branch; check = the commit it resolved to
#   jar         source = Maven Central path; pin = version; check = sha256 of the jar
#   tarball     source = URL; pin = version; check = sha256 of the tarball
# Everything is fetched into competitors/third_party/ (gitignored); nothing here is built.
# (the hash drivers read the xxhash pin from third_party/xxhash, where this file's
#  vendorlock fetch puts it; vendor/xxhash is vendor.sh's optional clone and is
#  only a fallback, so the C++ rows no longer skip on a machine set up by setup.sh)
# --- C++ additions for time/ and hash/ (unit 8, spec §6.4, §6.5) ---
# date: Howard Hinnant's date.h, header-only, for date::parse (libstdc++ 13 has
# zoned_time and std::format for chrono but no std::chrono::parse; GCC 14 adds it).
# siphash: the SipHash-2-4 reference C implementation (Aumasson and Bernstein).
# boost::hash_combine, header-only: container_hash and the three it includes.
# --- C++ additions for concurrent/ (Channel.md: moodycamel; header-only) ---
# --- device reference suites (§6.13, §8.3): fetched only, never built here ---
# --- Java jars (Maven Central, transitive closure as resolved by Maven 3.8.7 on 2026-10-25) ---
# Jackson stays at the vendor/jackson.lock versions (2.22.0 / 2.22); setup.sh cross-checks.
# --- math/ Java jars (unit 11; Maven Central, transitive closure by the poms on 2026-10-25) ---
# JTransforms 3.1 needs JLargeArrays 1.5 and commons-math3 (3.5 in its pom; 3.6.1 is
# binary-compatible and is the Commons Math the stats rows use). npy is Kotlin: kotlin-stdlib.
# --- Java jars for hash/ (unit 8): XXH3 for the xxhash3 rows, SipHash-2-4 for siphash ---
# --- collection/ Cache and ltm (unit 6): Caffeine; RocksJava; lmdbjava with its jnr-ffi closure (Maven 3.8.7, 2026-10-25) ---
